name: The first case study: the reminder desk
facts: The first YouTube case study goes up on 21 December 2026: one VSP system, the reminder desk, told as how it was designed and what it changed.
It is 30 to 45 minutes long, on the Venture Drafters YouTube channel.
The system was designed for my family's firm, VSP Consultants, which runs on it every day.
No client, lender or staff detail is shown; the screens are a demo copy with invented data.
notes: Example campaign written for the content audit of 30 October 2026; confirm the date and the link before any piece is placed.
